Nanonets grew from 35 to 325 employees between 2021 and 2026, raising $41M along the way, most recently a Series B in March 2024.

## About

Nanonets makes software that extracts and processes data from business documents like invoices and medical records, feeding it into systems like SAP. Its pitch is replacing manual data entry with AI agents that handle complex workflows for large enterprises.

The company has grown to 325 employees since its 2017 founding, with Accel and Ashton Kutcher among its investors. Its recent Series B suggests scaling ambitions, though headcount growth rates aren't disclosed.
